Letter of Representation
2-11-25
Claims Department
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Re: Claim C-1095
Our client: Anthony Vega
Date of loss: 1-26-25
Dear Claims Representative:
This office represents our client in connection with injuries sustained in a side-impact collision at an intersection. Please direct all
further communication regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, or
electronic means. If your insured has already provided a statement or been in contact with our client, please let us know so that
we may address it.
We request that you disclose the full liability and bodily injury policy limits applicable to your insured, along with a certified
copy of the declarations page and any excess or umbrella coverage that may apply. Please confirm in writing that you will
preserve all evidence relating to this loss, including the claim file, photographs, recorded statements, vehicle data, repair and
total-loss records, dispatch and call logs, and any video or telematics information in your posssesion or under your control.
Our client's medical treatment is ongoing, and we will forward documentation of injuries, treatment, and related expenses as it
becomes available. We look forward to your prompt written response confirming receipt of this letter and the requested
information.
Sincerely,
Jennifer Black
Montoya & Solis Law Group
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
